name: core.openwop.workflows.commerce
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0152) — the Commerce operations cluster (ecommerce gap plan §5C C8): Post-Purchase Thank-You, Low-Stock Reorder Draft, and the Order Exception Digest. Designed to bind to the ADR 0221 host events (host.commerce.order.paid, host.commerce.inventory.low-stock — create a host-event binding to enroll; ADR 0208) or the schedule trigger. Every outbound send rides the governed email-send integration node (drafts/approval per the tenant's actionPolicy — ADR 0033) and the ONE notification seam; order data flows through feature.commerce.nodes over ctx.features.commerce, so the ADR 0221 audit rows + spend thresholds apply by construction. Enrollment state = the run itself; a binding fires one run per event.
author: openwop

chains.label: Post-Purchase Thank-You
chains.description: On order paid (bind to host.commerce.order.paid): the trigger payload's orderId reaches the order read (a manual run passes `orderId` instead), AI-compose a grounded thank-you, human sign-off, then the governed email-send to `recipientEmail`. ADR 0875 D11: the recipient is still a fixed address (the order's own contact needs a gate-safe recipient lane — follow-up COM2WF-9); re-fires are deduped only by the email-send idempotency key.

orderId.description: The paid order for a MANUAL run. An event-bound run reads it from the trigger payload instead (ADR 0875 D11).

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Set it to fix a provider into those nodes when the workflow is created. Leave it unset and each run uses the run's chosen provider, else the workspace's AI setting, else the host's catalog default (ADR 0903); whichever is chosen is recorded on the run, so a replay or fork uses the same one. The workspace needs a key for the provider that runs.

model.description: Model id for this chain's model-calling nodes. Must be offered by the provider in the host catalog. Leave it unset to use the provider's model from the same choice (ADR 0903).

senderEmail.description: Verified sender address these emails are sent from.

recipientEmail.description: The address this email is sent to.

emailSubject.description: Subject line for the sent email.

triggerEventName.description: The host event this chain ignites on. The event belongs to the INSTALLING HOST, not the pack (ADR 0683) — defaulted to this host's v2 name for it; bind the workflow to that event to enroll.

config.systemPrompt: Write a short post-purchase thank-you email for this order (tone: {{params.tone}}). Ground every detail in the order data; never invent items or amounts.

config.title: Approve this thank-you email before it is sent

chains.label: Low-Stock Reorder Draft
chains.description: On a low-stock crossing (bind to host.commerce.inventory.low-stock): read THAT product (from the trigger payload, or `productId` on a manual run), draft a supplier reorder email, hold it at a purchasing sign-off gate, then the governed send + an owner notification carrying the draft. Never mutates inventory.

supplierHint.description: Optional supplier name/email to address the draft to.

chains.label: Order Exception Digest
chains.description: On a schedule (pair with core.trigger.schedule): list orders, AI-summarize the exceptions — paid-but-unfulfilled beyond the SLA, aging pending reservations — and push the summary to the operations inbox (the digest node's output flows to the notification via the edge, the corpus convention). Read-only; escalation stays human.
